profile.name: Hayley Chen
profile.target: Early-career HR roles in HRBP, COE, C&B, OD, Learning & Development, HR Operations, and Employee Experience.

sections.title: 币安 / Binance - 薪酬福利实习生 COE / C&B Intern
sections.contentCN:
【数字化管理】整理内部员工保险文件知识库，实现90%+文件可查率；通过Clawbot搭建一体化Wellbeing Portal，根据需求整合内部活动以及外部健康资源，预计6月上线推广。
【福利运营】全流程支持菲律宾、越南、巴西多国人寿、医疗险及全球EAP的合同续约，端到端处理成本测算、供应商议价、合同签署、员工Briefing以及记录归档，有效压降保费涨幅；越南HC涨50%的情况下保持整体保费成本涨幅在20%以内。
【活动运营】独立落地3场健康线上讲座及员工分享活动，场均满意度稳定4.0/5.0以上，提升员工健康参与度；开发Wellness Webinar的Clawbot Skill，实现自动进行数据记录与场次分析，提升人工复盘效率。
sections.contentEN:
Established a standardized benefit knowledge base and visual dashboard for centralized management of insurance contracts and relevant documents, achieving 90%+ document accessibility. Built an integrated wellbeing portal via internal bot to connect internal tools and external resources, greatly improving employee self-service efficiency.
Led end-to-end renewal of medical insurance in the Philippines, Vietnam and Brazil, including cost estimation, multi-round vendor negotiation, contract signing and employee briefing, successfully cutting premium growth and optimizing annual benefit budget; controlled premium cost growth within 2% in Vietnam.
Independently launched 3 wellness webinars and one employee sharing session with a stable average satisfaction score above 4.0/5.0. Developed an activity data dashboard and built automated data recording and analysis capabilities via Clawbot Skill, boosting manual review efficiency by over 60% and supporting real-time data accumulation.

sections.title: 怡安翰威特咨询 / Aon Hewitt Consulting - 组织与绩效管理实习生 / Intern of Performance and Talent Development
sections.contentCN:
【访谈建模】更新集团企业在新背景下的经营领导力素质要求，对管理层进行访谈，结合对战略文件的编码和数据分析，基于怡安素质库模型建立对该国企客户的领导力素质模型，并定义子维度展现。
【人才测评】结合BEI访谈，进行关键行为提取，引入AI打分作为辅助，针对被测评者的各素质项进行分析及打分，交付BEI个人报告；组织360测评，梳理评价关系；策划沙盘测评，结合素质模型设计沙盘评分方案。
【报告输出】输出结合各个测评结果产出总结报告；利用AI辅助做文献分析、相关质性研究，输出韧性领导力专题报告。
sections.contentEN:
Conducted management interviews to update leadership competency requirements; developed a leadership quality model for a state-owned enterprise client by coding strategic documents and defining sub-dimensions based on the Aon Competency Library.
Extracted key behaviors via BEI interviews; introduced AI scoring to evaluate competencies; organized a 360-degree assessment and designed a sandtable evaluation scheme aligned with the competency model.
Delivered individual assessment reports and produced an integrated summary report based on full evaluation results.

sections.title: 美的国际 / Midea International Business - 薪酬绩效实习生 国际业务部 / Compensation & Performance Intern
sections.contentCN:
【薪酬绩效】参与绩效政策简化改革及绩效沟通新界面中英文发版，组织2次UAT及后续答疑；参与新并购公司TLSC的绩效政策分权拆解，分解对比薪酬绩效相关流程及审批流；参与人力变革3.0案头研究，重新整合3批顾问的调查底稿。
【外派管理】参与EOR新供应商的议价与引入，同时进行海外属地挂靠人员梳理，将所有遗留在事业部的Local Hire员工信息归真到海外BU；调研分析埃及及印尼员工广领员工的保险及其他津贴福利水平，更新埃及工厂保险；参与2025年度外派福利政策整理与宣贯。
【政策整合】福利水平分析，主动发现问题并形成清晰的外派员工探索福利指引手册。
【数据治理】参与人力数字化变革中信息基础数据治理项目，与IT持续更新适用所有BU的统一人员信息字段，与海外BU HR对齐，目前已实现Band类员工信息完整度从10%达到90%。
sections.contentEN:
Supported corporate KPI policy simplification and the bilingual release of a new performance communication interface. Executed 2 UAT cycles for the performance system upgrade and managed post-launch user support.
Mapped 15+ compensation workflows through RACI matrix analysis for M&A integration of the TLSC entity, and consolidated 3 batches of consultant research for HR transformation policy alignment.
Assisted EOR vendor procurement through negotiation and onboarding. Centralized legacy Local Hire records to overseas BU systems.
Benchmarked Egypt and Indonesia benefit packages, updated Egypt insurance schemes, and developed expatriate family visitation guidelines during 2025 policy consolidation.
Standardized cross-BU employee data fields with IT and overseas BU HR teams, achieving Band-level profile completeness growth from 10% to 90%.

sections.title: 京东工业 / JD.com Industry - HRBP实习生 BOM业务部&工业国际团队 / HRBP & Sales Support Intern
sections.contentCN:
【招聘对齐】协助进行组织架构调整的设计和汇报；根据经分侧拆分的GMV目标月度调整人力预算及HC，与招聘侧对齐招聘节奏，为各业务部门提发展情况动态调整HC分配，进行社招招聘需求提报。
【人才考评】完成Q2绩效核算、Q3目标制定；组织部门年中晋升项目及日常转正会。
【培训运营】运营“夏季专业力大练兵”“中区域商品方案岗&解决方案岗（内称店长&院长）”的系列培训，前期宣发、现场主持、组织培训11场。
sections.contentEN:
Aligned with recruitment and accounting colleagues to output the latest annual manpower budget of the department based on structure inventory.
Organized the "Spitball Conference" to collect dissatisfaction from overseas colleagues in the field, collected 58 spitballs, and set up 3 special improvement groups.
Cooperated with the COE team, interviewed 18 employees, and focused on improving the positioning of the Merchandise Solutions position.

sections.title: 北京字节跳动科技有限公司 / TikTok Shop - HR实习生 国际化电商 / HR Intern International E-Commerce
sections.contentCN:
【需求对齐】支持国际化电商某五个团队Q3&Q4需求，共计headcount 38个，跨时区与用人团队不断对齐招聘画像，与用人部门HRBP对齐用人标准与人头数，形成针对不同岗位的画像文档。
【人才获取】从人才库与第三方平台多渠道捞取予用人经理评估简历超1500份，面试转化率10%，对对标公司的目标团队进行定向mapping形成系统导图；为提高到面转化率，通过cold call联系人选，实现确定意向、交换诉求、信息交流、转化为流程等结果。
【成果产出】每周团队保持在2个及以上offer，为国际化电商实习生需求贡献10+offer，直接产出6个高阶offer，其中包含3个高阶人选，获得某temu人选在HR面中的高度评价。
sections.contentEN:
Supported Q3 and Q4 hiring requirements for 5 international e-commerce groups, covering 38 positions. Aligned recruitment profiles and hiring standards with HRBP and hiring managers.
Sourced over 1,500 resumes through talent pools and third-party platforms. Achieved a stable interview conversion rate of 10% and mapped target teams of benchmarking companies to create a systematic roadmap.
Implemented cold-call outreach to improve interview attendance, facilitating intention confirmation, demand and information exchange, and process conversion.
Contributed 10+ offers to international e-commerce internship needs and directly delivered 6 regular-employee offers.

sections.title: ByteDance - HR Intern, International E-commerce
sections.contentCN: 北京字节跳动科技有限公司｜HR 实习生（国际化电商）：支持国际化电商多个团队 Q3/Q4 需求，共计 headcount 38 个；跨时区与用人团队沟通招聘画像，并与 HRBP 对齐用人标准与业务转化问题；从人才库与第三方平台多渠道捞取候选人，评估简历超 1500 份；通过 cold call 联系候选人，推动意向确认、信息交流、转化和流程跟进；每周团队保持 2 个及以上 offer，为实习生需求贡献 10+ offer。
sections.contentEN: ByteDance | HR Intern, International E-commerce: Supported Q3/Q4 hiring needs across multiple international e-commerce teams with 38 headcount in total; communicated with hiring teams across time zones to clarify candidate profiles and aligned hiring standards with HRBPs; sourced candidates from internal talent pools and external platforms, reviewing over 1,500 resumes; conducted cold calls to confirm interest, exchange information, and drive conversion; helped the team maintain at least two offers per week and contributed 10+ internship offers.

profile.name: Hayley Chen
profile.target: 2027 Mainland China early-career roles in HRBP, COE, C&B, OD, Talent Development, HR Operations, Employee Experience, and HR Digitalization.

sections.title: 香港中文大学 / The Chinese University of Hong Kong - 电商与物流技术硕士 / MSc in E-Commerce and Logistics Technologies
sections.contentCN: 海外QS前100。核心课程：电子支付系统（密码学）、物流管理、数据挖掘技术、网络编程（HTML/CSS/JavaScript）、工程经济学等。
sections.contentEN: QS Top 100 university. Core coursework includes Electronic Payment Systems (Cryptography), Logistics Management, Data Mining Techniques, Web Programming (HTML/CSS/JavaScript), and Engineering Economics.

sections.title: 南昌大学 / Nanchang University - 工商管理本科 / BBA in Business Administration
sections.contentCN: 211、双一流，经济管理学院。核心课程：公司治理、商务数据分析、Python、管理学、公共关系学、人力资源管理、管理决策与方法、市场营销等。
sections.contentEN: Project 211 and Double First-Class university, School of Economics and Management. Core coursework includes Corporate Governance, Business Data Analytics, Python, Management, Public Relations, Human Resource Management, Management Decision-Making and Methods, and Marketing.

sections.title: 币安 / Binance - 薪酬福利实习生 / Compensation & Benefits Intern
sections.contentCN:
【福利管理】全流程支持菲律宾、越南、巴西人寿及医疗保险和全球EAP续约；基于历史理赔、HC与保费进行成本分析和方案对比，参与Broker与Insurer议价、合同签署和员工沟通。越南HC增长50%的情况下，结合较低历史Loss Ratio，将总保费涨幅控制在20%。
【AI与数字化管理】使用AI Agent搭建一体化Wellbeing Portal，整合健康、心理、财务与社交四类资源，以及保险政策、EAP、内部活动和外部健康资源，形成一站式员工自助入口；搭建保险问答Agent，处理跨国家、保险公司和方案的碎片化及频繁更新信息。
【活动运营】独立落地4场健康线上讲座及员工分享活动，满意度稳定在4.0/5.0以上；开发Wellness Webinar Clawbot Skill，实现活动记录与场次分析自动化。
sections.contentEN:
【Benefits Management】Supported end-to-end renewals for life and medical insurance in the Philippines, Vietnam, and Brazil, as well as the global EAP. Analyzed historical claims, headcount, and premiums; compared options; and supported broker and insurer negotiations, contracting, and employee communications. Kept the total premium increase to 20% despite 50% headcount growth in Vietnam by leveraging the plan's low historical loss ratio.
【AI & Digitalization】Built an AI-agent-enabled Wellbeing Portal integrating health, mental, financial, and social resources, including insurance policies, EAP, internal events, and external health resources, into a one-stop employee self-service experience. Built an insurance Q&A agent for fragmented and frequently changing country, insurer, and plan information.
【Program Operations】Independently delivered four wellness webinars and employee-sharing sessions with satisfaction consistently above 4.0/5.0. Developed a Wellness Webinar Clawbot Skill to automate activity records and session analysis.

sections.title: 怡安·翰威特咨询 / Aon Hewitt Consulting - 人才发展项目实习生 / Talent Development Project Intern
sections.contentCN:
【领导力模型】为大型国企领导力模型项目编码战略文件并参与管理层访谈，将洞察与怡安素质库匹配，搭建模型并定义各子维度。
【人才测评】参与BEI、360度和沙盘模拟测评；提取行为证据，使用AI辅助素质分析与评分并交付个人报告；梳理360度评价关系与交付流程；依据素质模型设计沙盘测评维度和行为标准。
【综合研究】整合多源测评结果并输出管理层测评及项目总结；使用AI辅助文献与质性分析，完成韧性领导力专题研究。
sections.contentEN:
【Leadership Model】Coded strategy documents and participated in management interviews for a large state-owned enterprise's leadership model project. Matched insights to the Aon Competency Library, built the model, and defined its sub-dimensions.
【Talent Assessment】Supported BEI, 360-degree, and business-simulation assessments; extracted behavioral evidence; used AI-assisted competency analysis and scoring; and delivered individual reports. Structured 360-degree rater relationships and delivery, and designed simulation dimensions and behavioral standards based on the competency model.
【Integrated Research】Integrated multi-source assessment results into management assessment and project summary reports. Used AI-assisted literature review and qualitative analysis for a study on resilient leadership.

sections.title: 美的国际 / Midea International - 薪酬绩效实习生 / Compensation & Performance Intern
sections.contentCN:
【绩效管理】参与绩效政策简化及绩效沟通界面中英文发布，组织2次UAT并支持后续答疑；参与新并购公司的绩效治理分权，梳理流程、权限与审批。
【国际薪酬福利】参与EOR供应商议价与引入，梳理海外属地用工与组织归属；调研埃及及印尼白领员工保险与津贴，更新埃及保险方案；参与2025年度外派福利整理并形成探亲福利指引。
【数据治理】与IT及海外BU HR协作治理全球核心员工数据，推动Band类核心数据完整度从10%提升至90%。
sections.contentEN:
【Performance Management】Supported performance-policy simplification and the bilingual release of a performance communication interface, organized two UAT cycles, and handled follow-up questions. Helped define decentralized performance governance for a newly acquired company by mapping processes, authorities, and approvals.
【International Compensation & Benefits】Supported EOR vendor negotiation and onboarding, and clarified local-employment records and organizational ownership across overseas entities. Benchmarked insurance and allowances for white-collar employees in Egypt and Indonesia, updated the Egypt insurance plan, and contributed to the 2025 expatriate-benefit review and family-visit benefit guide.
【Data Governance】Worked with IT and overseas BU HR teams on global core employee data governance, increasing completeness of Band-level core data from 10% to 90%.

sections.title: 京东工业 / JD.com Industry - BOM业务部及工业国际团队HRBP实习生 / HRBP Intern
sections.contentCN:
【人力规划】为年中组织调整及下半年规划搭建员工级人力成本测算，滚动预测HC、人员异动、薪资与津贴，并结合GMV及业务拓展更新HC方案、支持策略会讨论。
【绩效与人才】完成两个部门Q2绩效核算，与TD对齐指标、评分及口径；处理岗位归属调整与员工答疑，支持Q3目标及系统维护，并组织晋升与转正项目。
【培训运营】运营面向中区域商品方案岗及解决方案岗的“夏季专业力大练兵”，完成线上线下共11场培训。
sections.contentEN:
【Workforce Planning】Built employee-level workforce-cost models for a mid-year organization change and second-half planning. Produced rolling forecasts for headcount, employee movements, salary, and allowances, and updated headcount plans based on GMV and business expansion for strategy discussions.
【Performance & Talent】Completed Q2 performance calculations for two departments and aligned metrics, scoring, and definitions with the TD team. Handled role-ownership transfers and employee questions, supported Q3 target and system maintenance, and organized promotion and probation-confirmation processes.
【Learning Operations】Operated the Summer Capability Program for regional product-solution and solution roles, delivering 11 online and offline training sessions.

sections.title: 技能与语言 / Skills & Languages
sections.contentCN:
【工具】Office、Power BI、Python、SPSS、前端开发、SQL、PR、剪映、社交媒体运营与文案、AI；Lightroom基础及人像摄影。
【语言】英语可作为工作语言，IELTS 7.0，CET-4 611，CET-6 520；粤语日常交流；韩语学习中。
sections.contentEN:
【Tools】Office, Power BI, Python, SPSS, front-end development, SQL, Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, social-media operations and copywriting, and AI; basic Lightroom and portrait photography.
【Languages】English as a working language (IELTS 7.0, CET-4 611, CET-6 520); conversational Cantonese; currently learning Korean.
